mapper.select: SELECT * FROM learning_record WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND attempt_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY attempt_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_record (student_id, course_id, knowledge_point_id, is_correct, score, attempt_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{knowledgePointId}, #{isCorrect}, #{score}, #{attemptAt})
